original: 私達は彼女に気をつけるように叫んだ。

en.text: We yelled at her to take care.
We yelled at her to watch her step.
We yelled at her, asking her to pay attention.
We yelled at her to be careful.

indices: 私たち{私達} は 彼女 に 気をつける 様に{ように} 叫ぶ{叫んだ}

original: 道路を渡るときは車に気をつけるのよ。

en.text: Look out for cars when you cross the road.

original: 電車に遅れないように気をつけるのよ。

en.text: Be careful not to miss the train.
Take care not to miss the train.
